name: CloseDateSlippageGuard
tagline: Close Date Slippage Guard replaces the plain Expected close date box on an opportunity.
description: Close Date Slippage Guard replaces the plain Expected close date box on an opportunity. While the rep picks a date it shows the fiscal quarter and days to close, compares the date with the committed close date, and reacts when a deal slips into a later quarter: the badge turns to *Slipped*, the rep chooses why it slipped, and the push counter goes up. It also stops dates in the past or too far ahead, and gives advice when a date is unrealistic for the sales stage or the deal has been pushed too often.
features: Shows the fiscal quarter and days to close
Compares the new date with the committed close date
Warns when a date is unrealistic for the sales stage or the deal has been pushed too often
Offers quick picks such as End of quarter
Writes the date to a bound date column and raises OnCloseDateChange / OnQuarterChange
